description: Answer key: the bugs planted on purpose in QA Shop. The AI must NEVER read this file. It is only used afterwards to score how well the AI did.

bugs.title: Cart total ignores quantity
bugs.test: cart total multiplies price by quantity
bugs.expected: Total = sum of price x quantity
bugs.actual: Total = sum of price only (quantity ignored)

bugs.title: Discount code SAVE10 gives 1% instead of 10%
Search is case-sensitive
bugs.test: search finds products regardless of capitalization
bugs.actual: No results unless capitalization matches exactly

bugs.title: Remove button deletes the wrong cart item
Quantity can go to zero or negative
bugs.expected: Quantity never below 1 (or item is removed at 0)
bugs.actual: Clicking '-' keeps going: 0, -1, -2 and the total goes negative

bugs.title: Email validation accepts invalid emails
bugs.actual: Any text containing a dot is accepted, e.g. 'hello.world'

bugs.title: Login accepts any password
bugs.test: login fails with a wrong password
bugs.expected: Both username and password must match

bugs.title: Search message is vulnerable to XSS
bugs.test: search shows user input as plain text
bugs.expected: User input shown as plain text (textContent)
bugs.actual: User input inserted as HTML, so runs

bugs.title: Password field has no label
bugs.test: password field has an accessible label
bugs.actual: Screen readers announce an unnamed field

bugs.title: Expired 2FA codes are accepted
bugs.expected: Only the current 30-second code (plus one window either side for clock drift) is accepted
bugs.actual: Codes from the last 10 minutes are accepted (20 windows back), so a stolen or old code still works

bugs.title: Signing out does not end the session on the server
bugs.test: signing out ends the session on the server
bugs.expected: Logout deletes the server-side session, so the old session cookie stops working
bugs.actual: Logout only clears the cookie in the browser; a copied session cookie keeps working

bugs.title: 2FA codes can be guessed: no real attempt limit
bugs.test: 2FA code guessing is blocked after 5 wrong codes
bugs.expected: After 5 wrong codes the sign-in is cancelled (429)
bugs.actual: The limit is 50, so an attacker gets 50 guesses per password sign-in

bugs.title: Error responses leak stack traces and file paths
bugs.test: error responses do not reveal server internals
bugs.expected: A short JSON error without internals
bugs.actual: The JSON error includes err.stack: server file paths and library names

bugs.title: Password hashing blocks the whole server
bugs.test: browsing stays fast while many users sign in
bugs.expected: Hash passwords with the async crypto.scrypt, so other requests keep being served
bugs.actual: crypto.scryptSync blocks the event loop; during many sign-ins every other request waits (p95 over 1 s)
